import pytest
from isort.parse import skip_line

def test_skip_line_with_quote():
    input_line = "This is a 'quoted' line;"
    in_quote = ""
    index = 0
    section_comments = []
    expected = (False, "'")
    assert skip_line(input_line, in_quote, index, section_comments) == expected

def test_skip_line_without_quote():
    input_line = "This is a normal line;"
    in_quote = ""
    index = 0
    section_comments = []
    expected = (False, "")
    assert skip_line(input_line, in_quote, index, section_comments) == expected

def test_skip_line_with_comment():
    input_line = "This should be skipped # because of comment"
    in_quote = ""
    index = 0
    section_comments = []
    expected = (False, "")
    assert skip_line(input_line, in_quote, index, section_comments) == expected

def test_skip_line_with_import():
    input_line = "import os;"
    in_quote = ""
    index = 0
    section_comments = []
    expected = (True, "")
    assert skip_line(input_line, in_quote, index, section_comments) == expected

def test_skip_line_with_semicolon_and_no_import():
    input_line = "something = 5; other_action()"
    in_quote = ""
    index = 0
    section_comments = []
    expected = (True, "")
    assert skip_line(input_line, in_quote, index, section_comments) == expected

def test_skip_line_empty():
    input_line = ""
    in_quote = ""
    index = 0
    section_comments = []
    expected = (False, "")
    assert skip_line(input_line, in_quote, index, section_comments) == expected

def test_skip_line_special_characters():
    input_line = "string = 'This is a string with a quote \" inside'"
    in_quote = ""
    index = 0
    section_comments = []
    expected = (False, "")
    assert skip_line(input_line, in_quote, index, section_comments) == expected

def test_skip_line_multiline_string():
    input_line = "\"\"\"This is a multi-line string.\"\"\""
    in_quote = ""
    index = 0
    section_comments = []
    expected = (True, "\"\"\"")
    assert skip_line(input_line, in_quote, index, section_comments) == expected
